HOW LONG DOES IT NORMALLY TAKE TO SHIP AND SEND A TRACKING NUMBER?
We normally process orders within 2–3 BUSINESS DAYS. Once your order ships, we send a shipping confirmation email with your tracking number. Check your spam or junk folder too. Carrier tracking updates can take another 24–48 HOURS to appear.
